breakdown.description: Dittus–Boelter (turbulent) correlation is applied in the laminar regime (Re=800).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the misapplication of the Dittus-Boelter (turbulent) correlation to laminar flow (Re=800). It only specifies assuming a pipe diameter to compute h=Nu·k/D, without correcting the correlation to an appropriate laminar one (e.g., Nu=3.66 for constant wall temperature). The core inconsistency—using a turbulent correlation in the laminar regime—is not resolved.
